tw: Kron aggrandizes Gran's dice to grand, giant size, and Gran cries, "Nice!"
twc: Kron 把奶奶的骰子吹成巨型尺寸，奶奶喊“不错！”
hint: 小骰子被硬吹成庞然大物。

tw: Kron eats the goose's green leaves, and the aggrieved goose grieves on his sleeve.
twc: Kron 吃了鹅的绿叶子，委屈的鹅趴在他袖子上哭。
hint: 叶子没了，委屈全哭进袖子。

tw: With agility, Kron juggles a giggling gill-fish, a lily and a silly kitty.
twc: Kron 身手敏捷，同时抛着咯咯笑的鱼、一朵百合和一只傻猫。
hint: 敏捷到猫和鱼都接得住。

tw: Kron agonizes over two wagons: one of nice nuts, one of nice nougat.
twc: Kron 对着两辆车苦苦纠结：一车好坚果，一车好牛轧糖。
hint: 选零食也能选到满头汗。

tw: At the snack bell, Kron leaps with alacrity, packs a black sack and cracks a pretty treat.
twc: 零食铃一响，Kron 飞快装满黑袋子，咔嚓咬开一块好吃的。
hint: 一听零食，快得带起风。

tw: Kron learns his lemon stand is alienable, so a little alien is able to buy it.
twc: Kron 得知柠檬摊可以转让，一个小外星人就把它买走了。
hint: 能转让，外星人都能接手。

tw: Kron's allotment from the lollipop lot is one lone mint.
twc: Kron 从棒棒糖堆里分到的那一份，只有一颗薄荷糖。
hint: 分配完毕，他只分到一颗。

tw: Kron floats aloft on a soft loaf, and the lofty crows scoff.
twc: Kron 坐在一条软面包上飘到高空，高处的乌鸦一脸不屑。
hint: 飞得再高，乌鸦也不服。

tw: Altruistic Kron truly gives a sick chick his tall ice pop and keeps the stick.
twc: 无私的 Kron 把冰棒送给病小鸡，自己留下棍子。
hint: 冰棒给别人，棍子留自己。

tw: Kron ambles with a lamb past the bramble, both nibbling a crumbly bun.
twc: Kron 和一只小羊慢悠悠走过荆棘丛，边走边啃酥面包。
hint: 慢慢逛，身后再乱也不急。

tw: Ambrose bakes an ambrosial rose roll, and Kron's nose tows him to the oven.
twc: Ambrose 烤了香玫瑰卷，Kron 被鼻子拖到烤箱前。
hint: 香到鼻子先走一步。

tw: Kron and Sammy the clam sign an amity treaty over jammy tea.
twc: Kron 和蛤蜊小萨米边喝果酱茶边签友好条约。
hint: 签条约，只为一起喝茶。

tw: Kron's amorphous pudding morphs into more shapes than Kron can count.
twc: Kron 的布丁没有固定形状，变出的样子多得他数不过来。
hint: 没有固定形，就变个没完。

tw: In the amphitheater, Kron serves fifty hams to a theater full of hungry lions.
twc: 在圆形剧场里，Kron 给满场饿狮子端上五十只火腿。
hint: 斗兽场里，他当上了服务员。

tw: Kron cranks his amp, and the amplitude of the pool waves tips his plump duck.
twc: Kron 把音箱开大，泳池波浪振幅大得掀翻了他的胖鸭子。
hint: 振幅一大，鸭子翻船。

tw: Knight Kron munches nachos and scrolls a chrome phone, a pure anachronism.
twc: 骑士 Kron 嚼着玉米片刷铬色手机，十足的穿越。
hint: 中世纪骑士，手里一部手机。

tw: An ancillary ant carries a silly celery behind Kron's big pancake cart.
twc: 辅助小蚂蚁扛着傻芹菜，跟在 Kron 的煎饼车后。
hint: 主角推车，小帮手扛菜。

tw: Annie the doe tells Kron a neck-high anecdotal tale, all hearsay and no proof.
twc: 小鹿安妮给 Kron 讲了个高到脖子的传闻，全是听说没证据。
hint: 全靠听说，证据为零。

tw: Tired Kron has anemia, so Nurse Neemia serves a knee-high bowl of spinach.
twc: Kron 贫血没力气，护士妮米娅端来一碗齐膝高的菠菜。
hint: 贫血没劲，菠菜管够。

tw: With an anesthetic, Kron rests in a nest while Nettie the vet bandages his toe.
twc: 打了麻药，Kron 窝在鸟窝里睡觉，兽医奈蒂给他包脚趾。
hint: 上了麻药，包扎也不疼。
